statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|$HOME|~|g"); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); cd "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" 2>/dev/null; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); status=''; [ -n "$branch" ] && { [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && status='*'; }; C='\033[38;2;0;180;255m'; B='\033[38;2;30;102;245m'; G='\033[38;2;64;160;43m'; Y='\033[38;2;223;142;29m'; M='\033[38;2;136;57;239m'; T='\033[38;2;76;79;105m'; R='\033[0m'; printf "${C}auraflow${R} ${B}${cwd}${R}"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf " ${G}${branch}${Y}${status}${R}"; printf '\n'; [ -n "$remaining" ] && printf "${M}ctx:${remaining}%%${R} "; printf "${T}${model}${R}"
statusLine.description: AuraFlow status: project:path branch* ctx:% model
